references.text: The account of Judah's sons Er and Onan, their birth and death in the land of Canaan because of their wickedness in the Lord's sight.
Judah's sons are mentioned, including Er and Onan who died in the land of Canaan, in the list of Jacob's descendants who went to Egypt.
The continuation of Judah's genealogy with the surviving sons and their descendants who were counted in the census.
The genealogical record in Chronicles confirming that Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the Lord's sight, and that the Lord put him to death.
